entities.title: Browser game
entities.summary: Everything that runs in the player's browser.
entities.purpose: Wires the pure engine to the page: the fixed 60-steps-a-second loop, recording, the title and table screens, the name form, the high-score client, and online games played in lockstep, taking turns.
boundaries: The rules live in engine/; drawing, controls and sound in ui/.
The relay for online games and the multiplayer lobby are the games hub's; this folder only connects to them.
name.ts is also bundled into the Worker, which cleans names the same way.
